text: Setting clear goals is essential for any successful project. One useful approach is using SMART goals, which means goals that are Specific, Measurable, Achievable, Relevant, and Time-bound. This method helps teams stay focused and know exactly what they need to achieve. It is also important to set milestones, which are key points in the project timeline that show progress. Deliverables, the concrete results or products you must complete, should be defined from the start. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters because everyone involved needs to agree on the goals and expectations. When all these elements work together, projects run more smoothly and are more likely to succeed.
